generated_by: Generated by scripts/generate_manifest.py from SKILL.md frontmatter (description, license) and skills/stages.json (stages). integration, source, upstream_commit, and status are curated here — edit them in this file, then re-run the generator.

accessibility.name: accessibility
accessibility.description: Audit a web UI for accessibility with the ultra11y engine (RGAA 4.1.2 on a WCAG 2.2 AA core, 102 static checks), fix what it finds, and re-audit. Use before shipping any web UI change and in CI on every UI change. A page that was never audited is not accessible. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

api-and-interface-design.name: api-and-interface-design
api-and-interface-design.description: Guides stable API and interface design. Use when designing APIs, module boundaries, or any public interface. Use when creating REST or GraphQL endpoints, defining type contracts between modules, or establishing boundaries between frontend and backend. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

architecture.name: architecture
architecture.description: Define a project's architecture before any code is written — stack choice as a decision record, file tree and invariants, public contract, layer rules, and dependency licences — and enforce it with a checker. Use when a calibrated brief exists and the project does not yet have a written architecture, or when a structural change is proposed. No code before the architecture is written. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

ask-questions-if-underspecified.name: ask-questions-if-underspecified
ask-questions-if-underspecified.description: Clarify requirements before implementing. Use when serious doubts arise. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

breaking-change.name: breaking-change
breaking-change.description: Detect breaking changes between two OpenAPI specs before shipping, so a change that breaks consumers never ships under the same version. Use before merging any API change and in CI on every spec change. OpenAPI 3.x only. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

build.name: build
build.description: Build one slice at a time, test first, with the four checks and independent verification before commit. Use when a scaffolded project exists and a slice from the calibrated brief is next. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

codebase-knowledge-builder.name: codebase-knowledge-builder
codebase-knowledge-builder.description: Study unfamiliar codebases and produce evidence-backed knowledge artifacts. Use for repository orientation, architecture mapping, subsystem tracing, onboarding, or codebase documentation. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

database-designer.name: database-designer
database-designer.description: Design a database schema: tables, relationships, indexes, normalization, SQL vs NoSQL, migration plans. Use whenever the user asks how to structure their data, which database to pick, or before writing DDL. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

diagnosing-bugs.name: diagnosing-bugs
diagnosing-bugs.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

finalize.name: finalize
finalize.description: Prepare a release, cut it, and hand it over — docs, release notes, CI gates, rollback plan, and monitoring — without publishing anything the user has not approved. Use when the work claims to be complete and ready to publish. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

frontend-architecture.name: frontend-architecture
frontend-architecture.description: A portable architecture style for React and React Native frontends, with feature modules, a strict server-state vs UI-state split, barrel-only cross-module imports, co-located styles, and component-promotion rules. State-management and styling agnostic. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

frontend-data-contracts.name: frontend-data-contracts
frontend-data-contracts.description: Type safety at the network edge of any React or React Native app, with one typed API client as the single fetch boundary, parse-don't-validate, one response envelope, one typed ApiError for every failure mode, and branded IDs. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

frontend-optimistic-mutations.name: frontend-optimistic-mutations
frontend-optimistic-mutations.description: The write path for any React or React Native app using a query/cache layer, with cancel in-flight queries, snapshot every affected cache, patch instantly, roll back verbatim on error, invalidate on settle, and idempotency keys created once at form init. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

handoff.name: handoff
handoff.description: Write a compact handoff file so a fresh session resumes the task — state, decisions, next steps, and pointers, never file contents. Also load an existing handoff and resume from it. Use when the user asks for a handoff, or when the context is large and the task is still open. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

i18n.name: i18n
i18n.description: Internationalize a project: language tags and negotiation, dates/times/time zones, numbers and currency, RTL layout, pluralization and ICU messages, collation, Unicode, and localization testing. Use when adding a language or locale, or when text, dates, numbers, or RTL layout must render correctly. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

idea-calibrate.name: idea-calibrate
idea-calibrate.description: Turn a raw idea into a calibrated, testable v1 plan before any code. Use when you have only an idea, a rough brief, or a feature request, and need the problem, user, success criteria, assumptions, and non-goals confirmed. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

idea-capture.name: idea-capture
idea-capture.description: Capture a raw idea the moment it arrives and keep it in a durable store, so it survives between sessions. Use whenever an idea comes up mid-work, in passing, or outside a calibration session — before it is lost — and when you need to find, promote, or drop a stored idea. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

incomplete-refactor.name: incomplete-refactor
incomplete-refactor.description: Detect an incomplete refactor — old names still referenced, removed files still present, stale tests still calling the old API — before calling the refactor done. Use after every rename, move, or API migration, and in CI on refactor branches. A green test suite does not prove a refactor is complete. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

independent-review.name: independent-review
independent-review.description: Review a change independently before it merges, with six focused reviewers reading the diff — not the author's summary. Use before committing, before creating a pull request, and after a logical chunk of work. The implementer is never the final judge. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

issue-triage.name: issue-triage
issue-triage.description: 3-phase issue backlog management with audit, deep analysis, and validated triage actions. Use when triaging GitHub issues, sorting bug reports, cleaning up stale tickets, or detecting duplicate issues. Args: 'all' to analyze all, issue numbers to focus (e.g. '42 57'), 'en'/'fa'/'fr' for language, no arg = audit only. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

mcp-builder.name: mcp-builder
mcp-builder.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK). Only invoke via the orcinus router.

monitoring.name: monitoring
monitoring.description: Use when setting up uptime and health monitoring, alerts, or on-call basics for a service already in production, so you learn it is down before customers do — health and readiness probes, alerting on SLO error-budget burn rather than raw counts, curing alert fatigue, on-call rotation with escalation, and a status page. NOT instrumenting logs, metrics or traces, or wiring OpenTelemetry (that is `monitoring-observability`). Only invoke via the orcinus router.

monitoring-observability.name: monitoring-observability
monitoring-observability.description: Monitoring and observability patterns for Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, Langfuse v4 LLM tracing (as_type, score_current_span, should_export_span, LangfuseMedia), and drift detection. Use when adding logging, metrics, distributed tracing, LLM cost tracking, or quality drift monitoring. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

mutation-testing.name: mutation-testing
mutation-testing.description: Check whether the tests actually catch bugs by mutating the code and seeing if the tests fail. Use after a slice passes its tests, before calling it done, and whenever a test suite looks green but unproven. JavaScript/TypeScript only. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

mutation-testing-python.name: mutation-testing-python
mutation-testing-python.description: Check whether Python tests actually catch bugs by mutating the code and seeing if the tests fail. Use after a Python slice passes its tests, before calling it done, and whenever a Python test suite looks green but unproven. Python only. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

orcinus.name: orcinus
orcinus.description: One integrated companion for building software with a coding agent, from raw idea to publish. Use when the user asks for the ORCINUS lifecycle — starting, continuing, or finishing a project through its stages — or asks what stage their project is in and what comes next.

orcinus-verify.name: orcinus-verify
orcinus-verify.description: Independently verify a code change before any claim of done. Use after any implementation, bugfix, or refactor, before merging, releasing, or saying a feature works. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

performance-optimization.name: performance-optimization
performance-optimization.description: Optimizes application performance across frontend, backend, queries, and databases. Use when performance requirements exist, when you suspect performance regressions, when Core Web Vitals or load times need improvement, when N+1 query patterns need fixing, or when profiling reveals bottlenecks. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

refactor.name: refactor
refactor.description: Safe, behavior-preserving code refactoring for any language. Detects smells (Bloat, OO, Couplers, Layers), applies Fowler & MVVM/Clean Architecture patterns, and runs tests per step. Triggers: refactor, clean up, extract, rename, simplify, decompose, god class, MVVM, Clean Architecture. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

registry-publish.name: registry-publish
registry-publish.description: Publish a package to a registry safely — prepare, check, dry-run, confirm, publish, then verify the published artifact actually installs and works. Use when shipping a new version of a package. npm first. No publish happens without the user's explicit written confirmation. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

scaffold.name: scaffold
scaffold.description: Set up a new project so build, lint, typecheck, and test all run from day one. Use when a calibrated idea is confirmed and there is no project yet, or when an existing project has no working checks. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

security-review.name: security-review
security-review.description: Review a change for secrets, injection, supply-chain, and unsafe patterns before merge. Use after any implementation, before merging or releasing, and whenever code touches auth, secrets, data, or external input. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

skill-creator.name: skill-creator
skill-creator.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

visual-regression.name: visual-regression
visual-regression.description: Catch unintended visual changes by comparing screenshots against a baseline. Use after any change to a web UI, before calling it done, and whenever a change claims to be visual-only. Web UI only; needs a browser. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

waza.name: waza
waza.description: Evaluate AI agent skills using structured benchmarks with YAML specs, fixture isolation, and pluggable validators. Use when running an eval or benchmark, testing an agent, or comparing results across models. Only invoke via the orcinus router.

webapp-testing.name: webapp-testing
webapp-testing.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs. Only invoke via the orcinus router.
